# Work Item Plan

## Work Item WI-001: 后端关卡 API 与静态托管服务

### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: 后端关卡 API 与静态托管服务
- kind: backend

### Goal
- summary: WHEN 服务进程启动 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以仅含 Node 内置模块的单进程同时提供 GET /api/levels 关卡数据接口与 web/ 静态页面托管。

### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法与选中关卡后的行为。
- non_goals: 不引入 npm 依赖、数据库、认证或外部服务。
- non_goals: 不编写或修改 web/ 前端页面与前端测试。

### Dependencies
- depends_on: []

### Inputs

### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- capabilities: GET /api/levels returns HTTP 200 with top-level JSON array of exactly 5 level items
- capabilities: each level item has non-empty string id unique within the data file
- capabilities: each level item has non-empty string name
- capabilities: each level item has difficulty being 简单 or 普通 or 困难
- capabilities: each level item has boolean unlocked
- capabilities: success response uses Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- capabilities: unsupported method on API routes returns HTTP 405 with JSON error body
- capabilities: unknown API path returns HTTP 404 with JSON error body
- capabilities: API error responses with status 500 or 404 or 405 use Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- capabilities: data errors return HTTP 500 with error code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE and user-readable message
- capabilities: error response body uses the shape {"error":{"code":"<ERROR_CODE>","message":"<user-readable message>"}} and the message contains no stack trace or internal path
- capabilities: HTTP 500 data error body example is {"error":{"code":"LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE","message":"关卡数据暂不可用，请稍后重试"}}
- capabilities: HTTP 405 body example is {"error":{"code":"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED","message":"不支持的请求方法"}} and HTTP 404 unknown API path body example is {"error":{"code":"API_NOT_FOUND","message":"请求的 API 路径不存在"}}
- contract_id: CT-002
- capabilities: createServer(options) accepts dataPath defaulting to data/levels.json
- capabilities: createServer(options) accepts staticRoot defaulting to web/
- capabilities: start({ port }) returns Promise resolving to object containing origin and actual port and stop function
- capabilities: origin is http://127.0.0.1: followed by the actual listening port
- capabilities: stop() returns Promise that closes the running server
- capabilities: default port is 3000 unless overridden by environment variable PORT
- capabilities: server imports only node builtin modules node:http node:fs node:path
- capabilities: port 0 binds an ephemeral port for parallel test isolation
- contract_id: CT-003
- capabilities: GET / returns web/index.html with HTTP 200 and text/html Content-Type
- capabilities: static file resolution uses node:path normalize and resolve with prefix comparison against staticRoot
- capabilities: static paths resolving outside staticRoot are rejected
- capabilities: backend static hosting tests use fixture staticRoot under tests/backend/fixtures and never read web/**
- capabilities: static file not found returns HTTP 404 with plain text response
- capabilities: static file not found 404 plain text body example is 404 Not Found

### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 实现 server/server.js 服务入口 THE SYSTEM SHALL 导出 createServer({ dataPath, staticRoot }) 与 start({ port }) 生命周期并路由 API 与静态请求、对不支持方法与未知 API 路径分别返回 405 与 404 的 JSON 错误。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN 实现关卡数据读取器 THE SYSTEM SHALL 读取并解析 dataPath 指向的 JSON 且校验恰好 5 项与 id 非空唯一、name 非空、difficulty 取值仅限 简单、普通、困难、unlocked 为布尔，任一不满足即产出 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE 数据错误。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 实现静态资源托管器 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以 node:path 规范化解析请求路径并与 staticRoot 前缀比对、拒绝越界路径、对缺失资源返回 404 文本。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005
- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN 编写 data/levels.json THE SYSTEM SHALL 恰含 5 个关卡对象且 id 非空且文件内唯一、name 与 difficulty 非空、difficulty 取值仅限 简单、普通、困难、unlocked 为布尔值。
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 编写 tests/backend 测试 THE SYSTEM SHALL 先写失败测试并以 tests/backend/fixtures 夹具覆盖数据缺失、解析失败、结构校验失败与 fixture staticRoot 的静态托管行为且不读取 web/。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-006

### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**

### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN 以 port 0 启动服务 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 Promise 且其结果含 origin 与实际监听端口与 stop 函数、调用 stop 后服务关闭。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN GET /api/levels 且 data/levels.json 有效 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 200、Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8 与恰好 5 项且 id 非空唯一、name 非空、difficulty 取值仅限 简单、普通、困难、unlocked 为布尔的顶层数组。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN dataPath 指向的夹具文件缺失、不可读、JSON 无法解析或字段校验失败 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 500 且响应体含 error.code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE 与不含堆栈和内部路径的可读 error.message 且 Content-Type 为 application/json; charset=utf-8。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN API 路由收到不支持方法或未知 API 路径 THE SYSTEM SHALL 分别返回 405 与 404 且响应体为 JSON 错误结构且 Content-Type 为 application/json; charset=utf-8。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN 以 tests/backend/fixtures 的 staticRoot 夹具请求页面入口、静态资源与越界路径 THE SYSTEM SHALL 从夹具目录返回文件、拒绝越界路径、对缺失资源返回 404 文本且全程不读取 web/。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN 运行 node --test tests/backend/ THE SYSTEM SHALL 全部用例通过且在零测试时判定失败。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend/
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: null
- manual_instruction: 人工审查 server/server.js 仅导入 node 内置模块且 tests/backend 夹具位于 tests/backend/fixtures 并不读取 web/。
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: false

### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: api_path=/api/levels; default_port=3000; port_env=PORT; start({ port }) 返回结构为 { origin, port, stop }; 错误响应形状以 CT-001 为准
- provided_contract_refs: CT-001
- provided_contract_refs: CT-002
- provided_contract_refs: CT-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-004
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-005
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-006

## Work Item WI-002: 前端关卡选择页

### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: 前端关卡选择页
- kind: frontend

### Goal
- summary: WHEN 用户打开关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以原生 HTML 与 JavaScript 经相对路径调用 GET /api/levels 渲染关卡名称与难度并呈现加载与可读错误状态。

### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法与选中关卡后的行为。
- non_goals: 不引入 npm 依赖、框架或浏览器自动化。
- non_goals: 不修改 server/、data/levels.json、tests/backend/ 与 tests/integration/。

### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001

### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels returns HTTP 200 with top-level JSON array of exactly 5 level items
- required_capabilities: each level item has non-empty string id unique within the data file
- required_capabilities: each level item has non-empty string name
- required_capabilities: each level item has difficulty being 简单 or 普通 or 困难
- required_capabilities: each level item has boolean unlocked
- required_capabilities: data errors return HTTP 500 with error code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE and user-readable message
- compatibility_policy: require_all

### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-004
- capabilities: web/index.html contains a container element with id loading
- capabilities: web/index.html contains a container element with id level-list
- capabilities: web/index.html contains a container element with id error-message
- capabilities: web/index.html loads web/level-select.js via script tag
- capabilities: web pages use only native HTML and JavaScript with no npm dependency
- capabilities: web/level-select.js references relative path /api/levels
- contract_id: CT-005
- capabilities: web/level-select.js exports testable entry initLevelSelect with injectable document and fetchImpl parameters
- capabilities: initLevelSelect calls fetchImpl with relative path /api/levels
- capabilities: initLevelSelect shows the loading container before data arrives
- capabilities: initLevelSelect renders each level name and difficulty into the level-list container
- capabilities: initLevelSelect marks unlocked=false items as locked and not selectable
- capabilities: initLevelSelect validates that the response is an array whose items satisfy the field constraints before rendering
- capabilities: initLevelSelect shows a readable error message in the error-message container without blank page when fetch fails or status is not 200 or response shape is invalid
- capabilities: frontend tests exercise initLevelSelect with DOM stubs without a browser

### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 编写 web/index.html 页面骨架 THE SYSTEM SHALL 提供 id=loading、id=level-list、id=error-message 三个容器并以 script 引入 web/level-select.js。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- task_id: TASK-007
- statement: WHEN 实现 web/level-select.js THE SYSTEM SHALL 导出 initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl }) 并实现加载态展示、响应形状校验、名称与难度渲染、锁定不可选与错误分支降级。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-009
- done_when_refs: AC-008
- task_id: TASK-008
- statement: WHEN 编写 tests/frontend 测试 THE SYSTEM SHALL 先写失败测试并以 DOM 替身与 fetch 替身驱动 initLevelSelect 验证渲染、锁定态与错误分支且不启动浏览器。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-010

### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**

- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN 打开页面产物 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 web/index.html 提供 id=loading、id=level-list、id=error-message 容器并以 script 加载 web/level-select.js 且该脚本以相对路径引用 /api/levels。
